title: EvoGenUI-Bench: Evaluating LLMs as Multi-Turn Generative UI Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2608.29387v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can generate interactive web interfaces, but reliable generative UI requires maintaining an executable artifact as user requests evolve. We introduce EvoGenUI-Bench, a benchmark for multi-turn interface maintenance comprising 150 five-turn tasks and 750 turns across three scenarios: information presentation, executable interaction, and tool-grounded external state. We execute generated artifacts in a browser and evaluate them using screenshots, source and DOM evidence, actor traces, and runtime logs. Beyond turn-level and episode-level success, we measure cross-turn retention with Adjacent Pass Retention. Across eight models, even the strongest achieves 74.9% Turn Pass while completing only 37.3% of five-turn episodes; APR further falls to 52.4% on tool-grounded tasks. Diagnostic analysis shows that presentation failures center on information architecture, interaction failures on derived-state propagation and afford

translated_title: EvoGenUI-Bench：评估大语言模型作为多轮生成式UI助手的能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够生成交互式网页界面，但可靠的生成式UI需要在用户需求不断演变的过程中持续维护一个可执行的界面制品。我们提出了EvoGenUI-Bench，这是一个针对多轮界面维护的基准测试，包含150个五轮任务和750轮交互，涵盖三种场景：信息呈现、可执行交互以及基于工具的外部状态。我们在浏览器中实际执行生成的界面制品，并利用截图、源代码和DOM证据、操作轨迹以及运行时日志进行评估。除了轮次级和回合级成功率之外，我们还引入了相邻轮次通过保持率（APR）来衡量跨轮次的能力保持情况。在八个模型的测试中，即使是最强的模型也仅达到74.9%的轮次通过率，而五轮任务的完整完成率只有37.3%；在基于工具的任务上，APR进一步降至52.4%。诊断分析表明，信息呈现类失败主要源于信息架构问题，而交互类失败则主要源于派生状态传播和可供性方面的问题。
tldr: 该论文提出EvoGenUI-Bench基准，通过在浏览器中实际执行生成界面并引入相邻轮次通过保持率指标，系统评估大语言模型在多轮生成式UI维护中的能力，发现最强模型轮次通过率虽达74.9%，但五轮任务完整完成率仅为37.3%，揭示了模型在跨轮次状态保持上的显著短板。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces EvoGenUI-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs as multi-turn generative UI assistants by executing generated interfaces in a browser and measuring cross-turn retention, revealing that even the strongest model achieves only 37.3% five-turn episode completion despite a 74.9% turn pass rate.
